docs.description: The Hard Thing About Hard Things by Ben Horowitz is a practical guide to the challenges of running a startup, written by a seasoned entrepreneur and venture capitalist. Horowitz shares his personal experiences of building, managing, and leading companies through difficult times. The book covers topics like making tough decisions, handling crises, managing employees, and dealing with the loneliness of leadership. Unlike traditional business books, it provides raw, unfiltered insights into the realities of entrepreneurship, making it a must-read for founders and CEOs. 4o
